{{Attr|Freeze}} |versus_send_cost = {{Money|300}} |versus_wave_unlock = 15 |versus_eco = {{Money|20}} |versus_number = 1-5 |versus_timer = 1.4 |versus_changes = 300 Health }} ==Description== The '''Molten Hazmat''' is an enemy that never appears naturally and is also never summoned by other enemies. The only way for it to appear is for another player to send it in [[PVP]], specifically the Molten Arena. It is nearly identical to the [[Elite Hazmat]], as they share most of their statistics except health. The '''Molten Hazmat''' has 100 more health than the [[Elite Hazmat]], however, because sending it changes its health to 300, they are effectively identical gameplay wise. ==Appearance== The '''Molten Hazmat''' has a dark green skin color. It wears a white and black hazmat suit, which consists of single glove, a vest, gas tank, shoes and a gas mask. It has three different walking animations that are randomly chosen when it spawns. ==Strategy== *Towers with high DPS, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Ranger]], [[Accelerator]] and [[Engineer]] can defeat this quite easily. *As this generally spawns in hordes, area of effect towers like the [[Electroshocker]], [[Mortar]] or [[Rocketeer]] can be useful against this. *Because of its immunities, knockback and freeze cannot be used to slow it down. **Stuns can still be used, but because of its [[Stun Immunity]] it will only be slowed down instead of fully stunned. *Because of its immunities, freeze and burn defense dropping towers cannot drop its defense. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} EliteHazmatStun.gif|Current stun animation (9 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseEliteHazAnim1.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, first animation variant (12 March 2025 – Present) CorpseEliteHazAnim2.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, second animation variant (12 March 2025 – Present) CorpseEliteHazAnim3.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, third animation variant (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} MoltenHazmatIconIG.png|'''Molten Hazmat''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Molten Hazmat''' is the first ever PVP exclusive enemy to get actually added to the game. **There were other enemies planned in the past, such as the [[Enraged]], Enraged Boss and Enraged Giant for the [[2021 PVP Maps|2021 PVP]], but they were never added alongside that version of the mode. *The '''Molten Hazmat''' has an [[Index]] entry but its [[Logbooks|Logbook]] is unobtainable. **This is the first evergreen enemy to have its [[Logbooks|Logbook]] unobtainable. ==Update History== *'''9 April 2025''' - [[v1.60.0]] **'''Molten Hazmat''' added. *'''23 April 2025''' - [[v1.62.0]] **'''Molten Hazmat''' removed. *'''23 July 2025''' - [[v1.71.0]] **'''Molten Hazmat''' re-added. **Number sent decreased from 1-5 to 1. **Health now changes to 300 when sent. ==Notes== {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Molten Arena PVP]]
